description: Call this when someone asks what to check in a house given its age, or before an inspection. Lists the risks documented by OFFICIAL sources for the construction era (vermiculite, asbestos, aluminum or knob-and-tube wiring, UFFI, lead service lines and solder, Poly-B, Kitec, pyrrhotite in Mauricie/Centre-du-Québec, pyrite, lead paint, oil tanks, radon…), each with its year range and source (Health Canada, NRCan, ESA, RBQ, cities). Year taken from the open roll when an address is given, or from "annee". A list of what to verify, never a diagnosis.

annee.description: Construction year, if no address or if the roll lacks it.

name: risques_annee_construction
title: Risques selon l’année de construction / Risks by construction year
